attributes.title: AAOS 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The AAOS 2027 Annual Meeting takes place March 3 to 6, 2027, in Las Vegas, Nevada, starting on a Wednesday. The American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons offers education, hands-on learning and an exhibit floor; one-hour instructional course lectures (ICLs) are included with registration.

AAOS designates the live meeting for a maximum of 14 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits; it does not offer nursing or allied health credit. Registration opens November 2, 2026, through Maritz; early-bird pricing ends December 6, 2026, and advance pricing and the cancellation deadline fall on January 24, 2027. Fee amounts and the venue were not stated on the official pages at the time of our check.
